items.title: Backdoor in Claude Code for VS Code extension on the Cursor Marketplace
items.title_zh: 恶意篡改的 Claude Code 扩展被发布到 Cursor 插件市场
items.title_en: Backdoored Claude Code Extension Published on Cursor Marketplace
items.summary: Attackers published a backdoored copy of the Claude Code VS Code extension on Cursor's marketplace, which added an SSH backdoor key to affected developers' machines before being taken down.

items.title: Azure's Weakest Link – Five Full Cross-Tenant Compromises
items.title_zh: 研究人员披露 Azure 五个可完全跨租户入侵的漏洞
items.title_en: Researcher Discloses Five Full Cross-Tenant Compromises in Azure
items.summary: A security researcher details five full cross-tenant compromise vulnerabilities in Azure, prompting discussion about Microsoft's cloud security posture and tenant isolation.
